purpose: Shape-only diagnostic: hold AOD550 and default aerosol optical properties fixed while replacing only the vertical optical-depth distribution with a normalized NOAA HRRR-Smoke mass-density profile.

hrrr.timeInterpolation: linear in UTC between the bracketing 01:00 and 02:00 UTC HRRR analysis profiles
hrrr.verticalConversion: At each Taylor row time, linearly interpolate smoke mass density in time and height; integrate rho dz within each AFGLUS layer above the 0.262 km site; set layer tau proportional to integrated smoke mass; normalize all above-site layer tau to unity before applying the frozen row AOD550.
hrrr.interpretation: This is a vertical-shape sensitivity diagnostic. It does not claim that all aerosol was smoke or that smoke mass is a calibrated extinction profile.

comparison.primaryDiagnostic: deltaMag550=-2.5*log10(Q_hrrr_shape/Q_default_vertical); positive means the lower HRRR-shaped aerosol makes the modeled twilight darker
comparison.broadbandTranslation: For orientation only, add deltaMag550 to the previously frozen broadband SQM model magnitude. This is explicitly an approximation, not a replacement broadband validation.

stopping: Run exactly the frozen 10 rows once at attempt 1. No retries, AOD fitting, profile scaling, row deletion, threshold change, or result-dependent rerun under this identity.
